name: SenseVoice-Small (INT8)
description: Alibaba Tongyi / FunAudioLLM multilingual non-autoregressive speech foundation model, exported to INT8 ONNX by sherpa-onnx. Emits native punctuation and inverse text normalization (ITN) at ~70x real-time factor (~60ms latency on Apple Silicon) with zero traditional-Chinese leakage.

benchmark.host: Apple M4 Pro (arm64), sherpa-onnx 1.13.8 CLI, 8 threads
benchmark.notes: Measured through the shipped runtime path (the sherpa-onnx-offline subprocess Tuff spawns), not through a resident recognizer: 0.43 s wall for a 4.20 s Mandarin utterance, RTF 0.102, with native punctuation and '甚至出现交易几乎停滞的情况。' matching the reference exactly. Two thirds of that wall time is process start plus 229 MB INT8 model load, which every invocation pays again; the same weights already loaded measure 0.06 s (RTF 0.014) in an in-process harness, which is the headroom a resident recognizer would recover, and which this runtime does not yet reach. The CER above corrects an earlier 0.0 on this row, which re-measurement could not reproduce: on the AISHELL-1 test split's first 100 utterances the model is exactly right on 78 of them (mean CER 0.0313; worst 0.500), and on all 300 it is 0.0393 with 217 exact. Scoring folds number spelling on both sides (17万 == 十七万, 8.7 != 87) and strips punctuation, so the model's native ITN and punctuation are neither rewarded nor punished; three utterances whose audio is cut short in the public mirror were dropped by cross-model consensus. Note that AISHELL-1 is inside this model's training data, so treat it as an upper bound — on THCHS-30, a different recording era, it measures 0.0485, and on that corpus with noise mixed in at 0 dB it measures 0.1035. For scale, whisper-base (148 MB, the previous default) measures 0.0711 on this project's synthesized dictation set where this model measures 0.0154, and it emits no punctuation there (0.61 recall against this model's 0.97).
